corrections.field_01: Strongest feature: The reply supplies a unified, comparative criterion: each theistic consideration must establish incompatibility with naturalism and show that divine agency explains, rather than presupposes, the relevant phenomenon. Principal limitation: This framework announces case-specific applications but, within the formulation itself, does not yet demonstrate that every proposed divine explanation lacks predictive content or cross-domain unification. Live burden: The reply must substantiate its criterion across cosmic origins, rational inference, and biological information while confronting the possibility that one personal cause could jointly illuminate disparate observations. Locked score: The fixed judgment appropriately reflects direct motion-level engagement, stable qualification, logical coherence, and comprehensive responsiveness, while retaining measured evidential caution because an evaluative framework becomes decisive only through successful, phenomenon-by-phenomenon application.
corrections.field_02: Strongest feature: The reply recasts fine-tuning as a comparative-likelihood question, combining uncertainty about probability measures over universes with the evidential counterweight of cosmic hostility to life. Principal limitation: The hostility comparison remains incomplete unless it specifies what a creator would produce, since expansiveness or conditions enabling moral agents could make uninhabitability compatible with theism. Live burden: The reply must defend why scale and habitability are more expected on naturalism, while showing that life-permitting conditions cannot outweigh the inhospitable background. Locked score: The fixed judgment appropriately recognizes a responsive, qualified answer to the central design inference, while preserving evidential restraint because the comparative force ultimately depends on defensible expectations under both hypotheses rather than a vivid spatial contrast alone.
